https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@bitinn/1.text: Now here are some hot tips for Godot users:  It turns out once you upgrade from AnimationPlayer to AnimationTree you can no longer control animation playback speed with speed_scale, nor can you change playback speed directly in state machine. You will have to setup a TimeScale blend node and set it as a parameter.  Which means you should probably start with AnimationNodeBlendTree as your root node for most playable characters, otherwise your options are very limited.   # GodotEngine    # GameDe

What a week! Anyway, back to my weekend Godot session.  I was figuring out what was caused my  character state machine to only return to idle after double jump.  And it turned out the best way to avoid state machine problem is to KEEP YOUR TRANSITION EXPRESSION SIMPLE.  In the end we only need 2 variables for all of these transitions: gravity and speed.  Doing is_on_floor() check in state machine is bad idea because there is no guarantee it has been updated this frame.   # GodotEngine    # Game
